title: 第4章 邓恩第5章 信息第6章 住房
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
莫甘娜垂下眼，只是稍微思考就做了决定，“愚者先生，我觉得这位先生说的不错。”
“愚者先生，我也觉得这是一个很好的提议，只要‘聚会’变成定期，有的事情，如果您不方便出面，完全可以转交给我们，当然，得在我们的能力范围内。”
愚者先生沉默了一瞬，仿佛在权衡什么，随后缓缓开口，“我是一个喜欢等价交换的人。”
“不会让你们无条件帮忙。”
“每个周一，下午三点，尽量独处，等我多尝试几次，弄清楚一些事情，或许你们就能提前请假，不用担心会处在不适宜的场合了。”
得到同意的回答，那位小姐似乎很开心，忍不住握紧拳头，在胸前轻摆了两下。
“那我们是不是该给自己也取个称号？毕竟不能用真实姓名交流。”
“好主意。”愚者先生简单的回答了那位小姐的话。
“您是愚者先生，来自塔罗牌，那作为一个定期的、长期的、隐秘的‘聚会’，称号得尽量一致，嗯，我也从塔罗牌里挑吧。”
那位小姐的口吻慢慢变得愉快，“决定了，我的称号是，‘正义’！”
“那先生和女士你们呢？”
“倒吊人。”那位先生很快给出了自己的答案，只剩下莫甘娜了。
“恋人。”
莫甘娜选择了自己印象最深刻的一张牌。
定下了代号，正义小姐再次确认了倒吊人先生的收货地址，转而提出了有关塔罗牌的话题。
提到了罗塞尔的塔罗牌这件事，莫甘娜有点儿紧张，毕竟传说中的罗塞尔大帝的塔罗牌，自己手上可是有几张的。
之前，莫甘娜不知道他们到底是什么，只是按照系统的要求将它们收集起来。
现在看来，那些丑不拉几，还画着同一个人的塔罗牌，居然还有不少的秘密？
莫甘娜忽然有点心虚，毕竟，那几张牌都不知道被莫甘娜放在哪里了，自己家的庄园那么大，应该有好好存放吧？
好在，没有人觉察到莫甘娜的不对劲，第一次塔罗聚会结束了。

廷根的早晨，阳光很好，透过稀薄的云层，为这座工业城市蒙上一层淡金色的薄纱。
刚刚参加完塔罗会的莫甘娜看了看现在已经快九点了，于是改变了自己原本的安排，径直来到了黑夜女神教堂，静静坐了几分钟，等那种参加地下组织的紧张感消退不少之后，起身，进入了告解室。
伸手整理了一下黑色长袍的领口，在主教询问了莫甘娜来历之后，拿出了那枚和红手套级别一致的徽章，从缝隙处递给了主教。
“我找廷根值夜者小队的队长做一下登记。”
content_en:
Morgana lowered her eyes and just thought for a moment before making a decision, "Mr. Fool, I think this gentleman is right."
"Mr. Fool, I also think this is a good proposal. As long as the 'gatherings' become regular, if it is not convenient for you to come forward, you can completely hand it over to us. Of course, it must be within our capabilities."
Mr. Fool was silent for a moment, as if he was weighing something, and then slowly said, "I am a person who likes exchanges of equal value."
"I won't let you help unconditionally."
"Every Monday, at three o'clock in the afternoon, try to be alone as much as possible. When I try a few more times and figure out some things, maybe you can ask for leave in advance and don't have to worry about being in inappropriate situations."
After receiving the agreed answer, the young lady seemed very happy. She couldn't help clenching her fists and waving them lightly in front of her chest twice.
"Then should we give ourselves a title? After all, we can't communicate with our real names."
"Good idea." Mr. Fool simply replied to the lady.
"You are Mr. Fool, from the Tarot cards. As a regular, long-term, secret 'gathering', the title must be as consistent as possible. Well, I will also choose from the Tarot cards."
The lady's tone slowly became cheerful, "It's decided, my title is, 'Justice'!"
"What about you, sir and madam?"
"The Hanged Man." The gentleman quickly gave his answer, leaving only Morgana.
"Lovers."
Morgana chose the card that impressed her most.
After deciding on a code name, Miss Justice once again confirmed Mr. Hanged Man's delivery address and then brought up the topic of Tarot cards.
When it came to Russell's Tarot cards, Morgana was a little nervous. After all, she had a few of the legendary Emperor Russell's Tarot cards.
Before, Morgana didn't know what they were and just collected them according to the system's requirements.
Now it seems that those tarot cards that are so ugly and depict the same person actually have a lot of secrets?
Morgana suddenly felt a little guilty. After all, Morgana didn't know where she had placed those cards. Her family's manor was so big, so they should have been properly stored, right?
Fortunately, no one noticed that something was wrong with Morgana, and the first tarot gathering was over.
In the morning in Tingen, the sun is very bright. Through the thin clouds, it casts a light golden veil on this industrial city.
Morgana, who had just attended the Tarot Club, saw that it was almost nine o'clock, so she changed her original arrangements and went straight to the Church of the Goddess of the Night. She sat quietly for a few minutes. After the tension of participating in an underground organization subsided a lot, she got up and entered the confession room.
He stretched out his hand to straighten the collar of the black robe. After the bishop asked about Morgana's origin, he took out the badge with the same level as the red gloves and handed it to the bishop through the gap.
"I'll check in with the captain of the Tingen Nighthawks Squad."
